name: Huitz’Plina Operative (CR 9)
body:
HUITZ’PLINA OPERATIVE
CR 9

XP 6,400
Huitz’plina operative 10
CN Medium magical beast
Init +9; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 17, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 deflection, +5 armor)
hp 78 (10d8+20+10)
Fort +6, Ref +13, Will +8
Defensive Abilities evasion, improved uncanny dodge, uncanny dodge

OFFENSE

Speed 45 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee +1 synthetic short sword +12/+7 (1d6+6 P, 19–20/×2), survival knife +11 (1d4 P, 19–20/×2) or +1 synthetic short sword +14/+9 (1d6+6 P, 19–20/×2)
Ranged laser pistol +12/+7 touch (1d8 fire, range incr. 50 ft., semi-automatic)
Special Attacks debilitating injury, sneak attack +5d6, spine assault (2d6+10 P, DC 17 half)

STATISTICS

Str 10 (+0); Dex 20 (+5); Con 14 (+2); Int 12 (+1); Wis 14 (+2); Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +7; CMB +7; CMD 22
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Technologist, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse (B), Weapon Focus (shortsword)
Skills Acrobatics +19 (+23 to jump), Climb +22, Escape Artist +19, Knowledge (arcana) +11, Knowledge (local) +21, Perception +17, Stealth +19, Survival +22, Swim +14
Languages Common, Huitz’plina, 1 other
SQ finesse training (short sword), into the unknown, operative exploits (combat trick PU [Weapon Focus], ever vigilant, expert leaper PU, firearm training, springboard, uncanny mobility), predreaming, prehensile tail, quick movement (+15 ft.), specialization (explorer)
Gear 2 potions of cure light wounds; Other Gear +1 microcord armor with the environmental protection modification CW, laser pistol, +1 synthetic short sword, survival knife, belt of incredible dexterity +2, cloak of resistance +1, ring of protection +1, 2 silverdisk batteries (10 charges each), credit stick (100 gp)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Predreaming (Su)

Once per day, a huitz’plina can spend a standard action to receive a hazy vision related to the outcome of an event, goal, or activity as far as a day into the future. This otherwise functions as augury with a 100% chance of successfully receiving a meaningful reply.

Prehensile Tail (Ex)

Huitz’plinas have long, flexible tails that can be used to carry objects. They cannot wield weapons with their tails, but they can retrieve small, stowed objects carried on their persons as a swift action.

Spine Assault (Ex)

Once per day, after a huitz’plina takes the total defense action and before the start of their next turn, they can as an immediate action launch a barrage of spines in a 20-foot radius spread centered on themself. Every other creature in the area must succeed at a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the huitz’plina’s Hit Dice + the huitz’plina’s Constitution modifier) or take piercing damage equal to 2d6 plus the huitz’plina’s Hit Dice; a successful save halves this damage.
